Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Cr centers seven S neighbors, while S centers show five-, six-, and seven-coordinate environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cr and S polyhedra, and corner-sharing between S-centered 5-vertex and 7-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites.
